pages.title: Optional Mod Support
pages.text: TFE's core terrain, climate, fauna, and plant features do not require optional addons. When a supported addon is installed, TFE connects to its compatibility hooks automatically; without it, the base content remains unchanged. See $(l:new_terra_earth/afc)AFC Compatibility$() for its tree integration.

pages.title: Greenhouses and Cellars
pages.text: Inside a FirmalifeEnhanced controlled greenhouse or cellar, crops, fruit trees, and berry bushes use annual-average temperature and stable hydration instead of outside seasonal weather.

pages.title: Choosing a Greenhouse
pages.text: TFCModernLife greenhouses control temperature from the current local temperature. These systems overlap, so choose the greenhouse expansion your pack needs instead of enabling duplicates.

pages.title: Immersive Aircraft Compatibility
pages.text: This mod does not add Immersive Aircraft recipes, so add those yourself; it only fixes Immersive Aircraft failing to recognize TFC water bodies. Immersive Aircraft now interacts with TFC water normally: buoyant aircraft no longer sink, and they drift along with flowing river water.

pages.title: Maps
pages.text: JourneyMap and similar map mods can identify and color the added terrain biomes.

pages.title: Datapack Extensions
pages.text: Servers and modpacks can also extend fauna spawning, tree species, and other compatibility settings through datapacks; the bundled datapack compatibility guide is intended for players and pack authors who need those extensions.

pages.title: Farmer's Delight
pages.text: With Farmer's Delight installed, its $(thing)Rich Soil Farmland$() takes part in this mod's crop growth with 30% soil fertility. See $(l:new_terra_earth/soil_fertility)Soil Fertility$() for every tier.

pages.title: Survivor's Rich Soils
pages.text: With Survivor's Rich Soils installed, its five rich soil farmland variants take part in this mod's crop growth with soil fertility from 30% down to -10%, and they can now be fertilized while empty as well. See $(l:new_terra_earth/soil_fertility)Soil Fertility$() for every tier.$(br)Note: in some versions, that mod adds its own fertilizer multiplier. Unless that is changed there, the five variants gain an extra +20% down to -20% on the fertilizer multiplier (from Lush to Reclaimed), while growth speed and yield follow the normal fertility calculation.
